info.title: One-The-Go Detection
info.description: Versioned application API. Measurement mode is the default. ResearchResult 1.1 requires current independent study, consent, hardware, calibration and model approval; legacy 0.1 results never carry research estimates. See shared-contracts.md and the authorized-model-execution amendment for state, idempotency, owner/generation and native evidence invariants. Unknown nested component metadata is rejected at runtime; CaptureAttempt carries a strict v0.1 measurement projection plus the named typed companion evidence.

ScientificMeasurement.title: Measurement
ScientificMeasurement.description: Proposed v0.1 saliva envelope. Limits are assay-specific; qualifiers are not impairment thresholds. See LLD for cross-field semantics.

concentration_basis.description: Basis of both original and unit-normalized concentration and analytical limits. No local dilution correction is performed.

correction_status.description: Whether the reporting laboratory applied dilution correction; preserve its report, do not infer or repeat a correction.

BearerAccess.description: Pinned issuer/client, access token_use, current token family and owner generation are verified on every operation.
